description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing email subscribers within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting email subscribers, along with validation rules and internal logic for handling email subscription data.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing email subscribers, providing CRUD operations, validation, and internal data handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles fetching a paginated list of email subscribers for a specific subscription ID, including sorting and filtering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new email subscriber based on request parameters.

methods.name: setParamsToEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Helper method to assign request parameters to an EmailSubscriber entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes email subscribers by provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'delete' endpoint.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific email subscriber by ID and subscription ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email subscriber with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' endpoint.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to generate common validation rules for the request body.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an EntityUniquePropertyOption to handle email uniqueness validation.
